name: Student U (Durham)
what_you_do: Year-round support for students who would be the first in their family to go to college. You get after-school and summer programs and tutoring. You also get college advice, leadership building and career exploration. It runs from 6th grade through college.
who_can_apply: Durham County students who go to Durham Public Schools. They must be first in their family headed to college, or qualify for free or reduced lunch. Students should be at or a little below grade level and have family support. Rising 7th to 11th graders can join. Spots vary by grade.
deadline_text: New student applications open October 20, 2026. Deadline is in January 2027 (no day stated). Information session in December.
how_to_apply: Print the form for your grade, add the latest report card, End of Grade scores, a teacher recommendation and family questions, and drop it at the W.G. Pearson Center, 1200 Spaulding Street, Monday to Thursday 9 AM to 6 PM. Chosen by lottery.
notes: Only 60 to 65 students are picked. A lottery picks them. The page does not state the cost to families. You can contact Karla Fernandez, Director of Operations. Her email is karla.fernandez@studentudurham.org.
